sammendrag: Mantas Sekmokas presented the state of play of Individual Learning Accounts (ILAs) and related schemes across the European Union at the conference Financing adult learning: The role of public funding held in Thessaloniki on the 20-21 October 2025. Conference information In response to the European commitment to increasing adult participation in learning, the Financing adult learning: The role of public funding conference aimed to provide an overview of the range of funding instruments available across the EU Member States, and to discuss the future role of public (co-) financing of adult learning. The debate focused on individual learning accounts and training funds, based on the results of dedicated Cedefop research projects. Related online tool Financing adult learning database
tittel: Individual Learning Accounts (ILAs) and related schemes across the EU
